exercises.q: What does за- add in зайти́ (“to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in”)?
options: (used with nouns, in place names) trans-
to the finish, to the end
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists зайти́ under this meaning of за-. Source: Wiktionary, «за-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-#Russian).

**Зайди** — зайти́ (perfective): to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch; (nautical) to call at, to enter (a port); (nautical) to get, to advance. Wiktionary: за- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does за- add in заби́ть (“to drive in (nail), to hammer in, to nail up”)?
options: an action after which the object ends up behind some boundary, real or imagined
doing the action of the base word in advance, or to store
covering, or being covered, with something
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists заби́ть under this meaning of за-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «за-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-).
**забил** — заби́ть (perfective): to drive in (nail), to hammer in, to nail up; to score (a goal); to beat up; to slaughter. Wiktionary: за- + бить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does на- add in найти́ (“to find”)?
options: to repletion, to satiation, to the full, enough, too much
a quantity of, a lot of
(added to nouns or adverbs, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'for' the noun or adverb, or in the state of the noun or adverb)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists найти́ under this meaning of на-. Source: Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).
**нашёл** — найти́ (perfective): to find; (figuratively) to think, to consider; to come across; to be located, to be situated. Wiktionary: на- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.
